source: art/residents-02/concierge.blend (the Concierge's prepared Tripo P2 master; see art/residents-02/provenance.json)
method: art/arms-01/prepare.py in Blender: keeps the vertices skinned mostly to the upper arms, forearms and hands (with their twist bones) and the whole Tripo humanoid skeleton, turns the model to face -Z with its right shoulder at the origin, and exports the idle clip alone (the Engine admits a skinned model with its clips); no provider call
limitations: The Tripo humanoid rig has no finger bones, so the gloves stay open: a hand cannot close on a grip.
The shoulders are cut where the body was removed; they sit out of the first-person view.
